card.name: Small linking words in general prose
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as "the", "between", "for" or "inter" in general web prose on history, science or society. They sit just before a noun phrase or descriptive term, and the surrounding text is not medical.

modes.label: "the" before a noun phrase
modes.description: The word "the" after a verb or preposition in history or science prose.

modes.description: Prepositions or word starts like "between", "for" or "inter" before the rest of a phrase.
